Cube¶

Slices, previews, sub-volumes, PV diagrams and noise of spectral cubes, and the binary routes behind the Kinematic Lasso and kinematic modelling. All routes need the token and the session that opened the dataset.

POST /v1/cube/preview¶

Downsampled cube for fast initial display.

{ "dataset_id": "...", "downsample": 4 }

Returns scalar_type, width, height, depth, range_min, range_max + base64 data.

POST /v1/cube/slice¶

Single 2-D slice.

{ "dataset_id": "...", "axis": "z", "index": 42 }

POST /v1/cube/subvolume¶

Spatial + spectral sub-region.

{ "dataset_id": "...", "x0": 0, "x1": 255, "y0": 0, "y1": 255, "channel_start": 10, "channel_end": 50 }

POST /v1/cube/pv¶

Position-velocity diagram along a polyline.

{
  "dataset_id": "...",
  "vertices": [[12.5, 40.0], [80.25, 41.0], [130.0, 90.0]],
  "width_pixels": 3
}

  • vertices — 0-based cube pixels (x, y); fractional values are honoured (rounded to 1/1000 pixel, the same values key the product cache and feed the computation). At least two distinct vertices.

  • width_pixels — samples across the path, one pixel apart, averaged.

Sampling: one sample per step along the path’s arc length, in angular space (the full pixel→sky matrix, so non-square and skewed pixels are handled; one step = the finer pixel); NaN-aware bilinear interpolation. The cube must have its spectral axis last (else 422 / valid: false).

Response: num_samples, depth, scalar_type, compression, positions_base64 (offsets in steps), positions_arcsec_base64, pixel_scale_arcsec_per_pixel (= arcsec per step), spatial_unit, data_base64 (depth × num_samples float32, channel-major), width_pixels, vertex_count, total_length (pixels), valid_samples, step_pixels, spectral_axis_type, spectral_axis_unit, spectral_coordinates_base64 (float64 little-endian, channel 0 first, may decrease), spectral_crval, spectral_cdelt, sky_matrix_arcsec (row-major 2×2, pixel offset → projection-plane arcsec), bunit, beam_major, beam_minor, beam_pa.

POST /v1/cube/noise¶

Noise statistics (MAD and sigma) over a spatial region and channel range.

{ "dataset_id": "...", "x0": 0, "x1": 127, "y0": 0, "y1": 127, "channel_start": 0, "channel_end": 63 }

Returns channel_start, channel_end, num_channels, mad[], sigma[], region.

Binary and mask routes¶

The *_bin routes below return binary bodies in one of two layouts.

Header-described volumes (/v1/cube/subvolume_bin, kinematic_model_bin, kinematic_levels_bin, kinematic_select_bin). The response has Content-Type: application/octet-stream and the body is the bare array with no in-band header: little-endian samples in C order over (depth, height, width), so x varies fastest (the point order of a vtkImageData). Shape and metadata travel in X-Visivo-* response headers: X-Visivo-Width, X-Visivo-Height, X-Visivo-Depth, X-Visivo-Scalar-Type (float32 or uint8) and, for the float32 routes, X-Visivo-Byte-Order: little. Floating-point header values are written with Python repr, so they round-trip exactly. Errors raised inside the computation come back as text/plain bodies carrying the message (not the JSON detail envelope); errors raised before it (unknown dataset, wrong dataset kind, request validation) use the usual FastAPI JSON detail.

12-byte frames (/v1/moment/result/binary, /v1/pv/result/binary). The body is a 12-byte big-endian header of three uint32 values, rows, cols and flags (always 0), followed by rows × cols little-endian float32 values in row-major order, with NaN for masked or invalid pixels. This is the layout BackendClient::parseBinaryFrame() reads.

Request bodies that carry a mask (mask_apply_bin, kinematic_fit_bin, kinematic_residual_bin) use the same wire as the kinematic_select_bin response: a raw little-endian float32 array of width × height × depth values (x fastest, a voxel is selected when its value is above 0.5), with its origin and dimensions in query parameters. The server reads the raw body and checks only its length (width × height × depth × 4 bytes, else 422); it does not inspect the Content-Type.

Common errors: 404 when dataset_id is not open in the session, 422 when the dataset is not a spectral cube. Routes that take a per-session compute slot answer 429 when all slots stay busy (VISIVO_MAX_CONCURRENT_TASKS, default 3, waited for up to VISIVO_TASK_SLOT_WAIT_S, default 15 s); routes on the heavy pool answer 504 when the computation exceeds VISIVO_HEAVY_TIMEOUT_S (default 900 s). Each entry says which of these apply.

POST /v1/cube/subvolume_bin¶

Binary variant of /v1/cube/subvolume: reads the voxel box [z0..z1, y0..y1, x0..x1] (0-indexed, inclusive) and streams it as raw float32 with no base64 and no compression. The bounds are clamped to the cube.

Request (CubeSubvolumeRequest):

{ "dataset_id": "ds_1a2b3c4d5e6f", "x0": 0, "x1": 255, "y0": 0, "y1": 255, "z0": 100, "z1": 163 }

Response: the box as little-endian float32. Headers: X-Visivo-Width, X-Visivo-Height, X-Visivo-Depth (of the clamped box), X-Visivo-Scalar-Type: float32, X-Visivo-Range-Min and X-Visivo-Range-Max (finite range of the box), X-Visivo-Spectral-Axis-Type, X-Visivo-Spectral-Axis-Unit (empty when the spectral WCS cannot be read), X-Visivo-Bunit, X-Visivo-Byte-Order: little.

This route does not take a per-session compute slot, so a client can issue several slab requests in parallel without hitting 429.

Errors: 404, 422 (not a cube, or a box that is empty after clamping: Invalid subvolume ROI. as text/plain), 500 (text/plain) for other failures.

POST /v1/cube/kinematic_model_bin¶

Builds a tilted-ring model PPV cube of a rotating disc with the same spatial and spectral grid as the dataset, for overlay on the data (see Kinematic model). Each sky pixel carries a unit-amplitude Gaussian line at its line-of-sight velocity; the cube is not renormalised.

Request (CubeKinematicModelRequest, all floats must be finite):

Field

Type

Notes

dataset_id

string

x0, y0

float

disc centre, pixels

vsys

float

systemic velocity

sigma

float

line dispersion, > 0

pa_deg

float or null

position angle, image-pixel convention (0 along +y, increasing toward +x)

incl_deg

float or null

inclination, 0 to 90

vrot

float or null

flat rotation velocity

rmax_pix

float or null

disc radius in pixels, > 0

rings

list

optional per-ring profile, each {r_pix > 0, pa_deg, incl_deg in [0, 90], vrot}

Without rings, all four scalar parameters (pa_deg, incl_deg, vrot, rmax_pix) are required (422 otherwise). With rings, the scalar ones are ignored, the radii must be distinct, and the disc extends to the outermost ring.

Velocities are in the unit the worker reports in X-Visivo-Spectral-Axis-Unit. A velocity axis is converted to km/s; a frequency axis with RESTFRQ (or RESTFREQ) becomes optical velocity (cz) in km/s, the same axis the kinematic fit uses; any other usable axis stays in its native unit; when the spectral WCS is unusable the axis is the channel index.

{ "dataset_id": "ds_1a2b3c4d5e6f", "x0": 128.0, "y0": 120.5, "vsys": 1450.0,
  "sigma": 10.0, "pa_deg": 35.0, "incl_deg": 60.0, "vrot": 180.0, "rmax_pix": 60.0 }

Response: the model cube as little-endian float32 (full cube dimensions). Headers: X-Visivo-Width, X-Visivo-Height, X-Visivo-Depth, X-Visivo-Scalar-Type: float32, X-Visivo-Peak (maximum model value), X-Visivo-Spectral-Axis-Unit (km/s, the native unit, or channel), X-Visivo-Spectral-Mode (velocity, native or channel), X-Visivo-Byte-Order: little.

Errors: 404, 422 (validation, not a cube), 413 (text/plain) when the cube exceeds the model voxel cap (VISIVO_KINEMATIC_MAX_VOXELS, default 268,435,456 voxels), 429, 504, 500 (text/plain).

POST /v1/cube/save_subregion¶

Crops the cube to [z0..z1, y0..y1, x0..x1] (0-indexed, inclusive, clamped to the cube), writes it as a FITS file in the Workspace Exports directory and registers it as a new cube dataset in the session. The header is copied from the source with NAXISn updated, CRPIX1/2/3 shifted by the crop origin and a HISTORY card recording the crop.

Request (CubeSaveSubregionRequest): dataset_id, x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1 (int), output_basename (default ""). An empty basename becomes <source stem>_subcube_x<x0>-<x1>_y<y0>-<y1>_z<z0>-<z1>.fits. The basename is reduced to its final path component, leading dots are stripped, .fits is appended when it has no extension, and an existing name gets a _1, _2, … suffix instead of being overwritten.

Response (CubeSaveSubregionResponse): valid, error, new_dataset_id, output_path, workspace_filename, width, height, depth, range_min, range_max.

Errors: 404, 422 (not a cube), 429. A box that is empty after clamping, and other worker failures, return HTTP 200 with valid: false and the message in error.

POST /v1/cube/mask¶

Blanks (sets to NaN) the voxels inside or outside a box and registers the result as a new cube dataset, persisted in Workspace Exports. The output keeps the full cube dimensions, header and WCS: the source file is copied and the copy is edited in place through a memory map, so masking does not load the cube into memory. A HISTORY card records the mode and the box.

Request (CubeMaskRequest): dataset_id, x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1 (int, inclusive, clamped), mode ("blank_outside", the default, isolates the box; "blank_inside" removes it; anything else is 422), output_basename (default "", giving <stem>_mask-<inside|outside>_x..._y..._z....fits; same sanitising as save_subregion).

{ "dataset_id": "ds_1a2b3c4d5e6f", "x0": 40, "x1": 90, "y0": 35, "y1": 80,
  "z0": 12, "z1": 48, "mode": "blank_outside" }

Response (CubeMaskResponse): valid, error, new_dataset_id, output_path, workspace_filename, width, height, depth, range_min, range_max. The range is that of the kept data, measured on the box for blank_outside and on a strided sample of the cube for blank_inside.

Errors: 404, 422 (not a cube, invalid mode), 429, 504. An empty box and other worker failures return HTTP 200 with valid: false.

POST /v1/cube/kinematic_levels_bin¶

Geodesic level fields for the interactive Reach slider of the Kinematic Lasso. The backend grows the selection once, up to a budget, and returns two uint8 fields over a shared bounding box; the client then derives the selection at any integer budget r locally as add <= r and not sub <= r, with no further request.

Request (CubeKinematicSelectRequest, shared with kinematic_select_bin and extended by mask_selection):

Field

Default

Limits

Meaning

dataset_id

seed_z, seed_y, seed_x

required

inside the cube, on a finite voxel

the clicked seed voxel

add_seeds

[]

each [z, y, x]

extra seeds whose selections are added (union)

sub_seeds

[]

each [z, y, x]

seeds whose selections are carved out; a sub-seed on a blank voxel is skipped

reach

8.0

> 0, finite

geodesic cost budget

lambda_v

1.0

> 0, finite

weight of a step along the velocity axis (1 is isotropic)

sigma

0.0

>= 0

intensity scale of the cost; 0 uses a robust (MAD) noise estimate of the cube

nsigma

2.5

> 0

threshold, in sigma units, of the emission component the grow is confined to

roi_radius

0

0 to 256

0 grows over the whole connected object (inside a 256-voxel half-size safety window around the seed); > 0 confines the grow to a half-box of this size

reach_max

0.0

0 to 254

budget of the level field; 0 uses reach

smooth_v, smooth_xy

0.0

0 to 16

Gaussian smoothing (sigma in voxels, velocity and both spatial axes) applied before the threshold; 0 is off

The budget is reach_max when it is positive, else reach; a budget above 254 is rejected (the field is uint8 with 255 as the unreachable sentinel). Smoothing affects only which voxels are selected, never the values written by the apply routes.

{ "dataset_id": "ds_1a2b3c4d5e6f", "seed_z": 57, "seed_y": 131, "seed_x": 140,
  "add_seeds": [[60, 98, 152]], "sub_seeds": [], "reach": 8.0, "reach_max": 40.0,
  "lambda_v": 1.0, "nsigma": 2.5 }

Response: two uint8 fields of width × height × depth bytes each, concatenated (the add field first, then sub), in the volume layout above. A voxel’s level is the ceiling of its geodesic distance, so for an integer budget r the test level <= r is exact. Headers:

Header

Content

X-Visivo-Width, X-Visivo-Height, X-Visivo-Depth

dimensions of the shared bounding box

X-Visivo-Origin

x,y,z of the box in cube voxels

X-Visivo-Full-Shape

width,height,depth of the cube

X-Visivo-Scalar-Type

uint8

X-Visivo-Components

2

X-Visivo-Range-Max

highest usable integer budget (floor of the budget)

X-Visivo-Peak

the unreachable sentinel level (255)

X-Visivo-Trim-Box

0, or the half-width of the seed-centred box the domain was cut to when the object exceeded the 4,000,000-node graph cap (the field is then exact for that box only)

Errors: 404, 422 (validation, not a cube, and as text/plain: seed outside the cube or on a blank voxel, budget above 254), 429, 504, 500 (text/plain).

POST /v1/cube/kinematic_select_bin¶

Grows the Kinematic Lasso selection at a single budget and returns it as a binary mask, for the isosurface preview.

Request: CubeKinematicSelectRequest (see kinematic_levels_bin). The mask is thresholded at reach. When reach_max > 0 it sizes the faint-margin shell around the object exactly as in kinematic_levels_bin, so the preview and the level field are built on the same graph; smoothing is honoured.

Response: the selection’s bounding box as little-endian float32 (1 selected, 0 not), not the full cube. Headers: X-Visivo-Width, X-Visivo-Height, X-Visivo-Depth (box), X-Visivo-Origin (x,y,z), X-Visivo-Full-Shape (width,height,depth of the cube), X-Visivo-Scalar-Type: float32, X-Visivo-Selected-Count (selected voxels), X-Visivo-Bbox (x0,x1,y0,y1,z0,z1, inclusive), X-Visivo-Trim-Box (as in kinematic_levels_bin), X-Visivo-Byte-Order: little. When nothing is selected the count is 0, the bounding box is all zeros and the body is a single zero voxel.

The body together with its origin and dimensions is exactly the input that mask_apply_bin, kinematic_fit_bin and kinematic_residual_bin accept.

Errors: 404, 422 (validation, not a cube, and as text/plain: seed outside the cube or on a blank voxel), 429, 504, 500 (text/plain).

POST /v1/cube/mask_selection¶

Re-grows a Kinematic Lasso selection from its seeds and blanks the voxels inside or outside it, registering the masked cube as a new dataset in Workspace Exports. Like /v1/cube/mask it keeps full dimensions and WCS, edits a copy in place, and adds a HISTORY card (mode, seed counts, reach, lambda_v).

Request (CubeMaskSelectionRequest): every field of CubeKinematicSelectRequest plus mode ("blank_outside", the default, isolates the selection; "blank_inside" removes it) and output_basename (default "", giving <stem>_lasso-<inside|outside>.fits). reach_max, when positive, sizes the margin shell as in the preview. smooth_v and smooth_xy are accepted but not used by this route; to apply a smoothed or hand-edited selection exactly as previewed, use mask_apply_bin.

Response: CubeMaskResponse (see /v1/cube/mask).

Errors: 404, 422 (validation, not a cube), 429, 504. An empty selection, a seed outside the cube or on a blank voxel, and other worker failures return HTTP 200 with valid: false.

POST /v1/cube/mask_apply_bin¶

Applies an explicit selection mask, sent in the request body, without re-growing from seeds, so a hand-refined mask is written exactly as shown. The masked cube is registered as a new dataset in Workspace Exports.

Query parameters:

Parameter

Default

Notes

dataset_id

required

origin_x, origin_y, origin_z

required

mask box origin in cube voxels

width, height, depth

required

mask box dimensions, each >= 1

mode

blank_outside

or blank_inside

output_basename

""

empty gives `_lasso-<inside

recipe

""

at most 4000 characters, key=value; key=value; each item is written to the output header as a HISTORY card prefixed Lasso

Body: the mask as raw little-endian float32, width × height × depth values, x fastest (the kinematic_select_bin wire).

POST /v1/cube/mask_apply_bin?dataset_id=ds_1a2b3c4d5e6f&origin_x=118&origin_y=96&origin_z=40&width=48&height=52&depth=30&mode=blank_outside&recipe=seed=(57,131,140);%20reach=8
Content-Type: application/octet-stream

<299,520 bytes: 48 × 52 × 30 float32 values>

blank_outside keeps only the selected voxels; blank_inside blanks them. The output keeps the full cube dimensions and WCS, and a HISTORY card records the mode, the selected-voxel count and the origin.

Response: CubeMaskResponse (see /v1/cube/mask).

Errors: 422 for an invalid mode or a body whose length is not width × height × depth × 4 bytes (both checked before the dataset lookup), 404, 422 (not a cube), 429, 504. An all-zero mask, a box that does not fit inside the cube, and other worker failures return HTTP 200 with valid: false.

POST /v1/cube/kinematic_fit_bin¶

Measures and fits a selection on the raw cube: integrated flux, line widths, geometry from the moment-0 map, a flat-disc tilted-ring fit and a per-ring fit, model velocity fields and their residuals against the observed velocity field. This is the input of the Kinematic Lasso comparator.

Query parameters: dataset_id, origin_x, origin_y, origin_z, width, height, depth (as in mask_apply_bin), plus sigma (default 0.0, >= 0: the noise used to cut the velocity field; 0 uses 1.4826 × MAD over every finite voxel of the cube) and min_ring_pix (default 150, >= 10: minimum pixel count of an annulus in the per-ring fit). Body: the selection mask (kinematic_select_bin wire). A mask box that extends past the cube is clipped to it.

The spectral axis must be the cube’s third axis and expressible in km/s: a velocity axis is used as it is, a frequency axis needs RESTFRQ and is converted to optical velocity (cz).

Response (JSON, NaN and infinite values replaced by null):

Field

Content

width, height

size of the 2-D maps (cube width and height)

velocity_unit, velocity_convention

km/s, and the convention used

sigma, sigma_source

noise used, and "noise estimate" or "robust, whole cube"

beam_area_px

beam area in pixels, 0 when the unit is not per beam or there is no beam

measures

flux, flux_is_jy, w20, w50, vsys_w20, n_velocity_field

geometry

x0, y0, pa_morph, axis_ratio, incl, rmax (from moment 0)

flat

pa, vsys, vrot, vrot_sini, rms

rings

list of {r, pa, incl, vrot, n_pix}

line_sigma, channel_width

line dispersion used for the model cubes, mean channel width (km/s)

residual_flat, residual_warp

{n_pix, median, p90, within_channel}; residual_warp is null with fewer than 3 rings

spectrum, spectrum_velocity

integrated spectrum of the selection and its velocity axis

velocity_field_base64

observed velocity field (moment 1), height × width little-endian float32, base64

model_flat_base64, model_warp_base64

model velocity fields, same encoding; model_warp_base64 is "" with fewer than 3 rings

Errors (JSON detail): 422 for a body of the wrong length, 404, 422 (not a cube, an empty selection, a selection outside the cube, a spectral axis that is not the third axis or cannot be expressed in km/s), 413 when the cube exceeds VISIVO_KINEMATIC_MAX_VOXELS (default 268,435,456 voxels), 429, 504.

POST /v1/cube/kinematic_residual_bin¶

Residual of a given model (fitted or edited in the comparator) against the selection’s velocity field, with the same selection wire and noise rule as kinematic_fit_bin.

Query parameters: dataset_id, origin_x, origin_y, origin_z, width, height, depth, sigma (default 0.0) as in kinematic_fit_bin, plus the model, all finite:

Parameter

Notes

x0, y0, vsys

required

line_sigma

required, > 0

pa, incl, vrot, rmax

single-disc model; incl in [0, 90], rmax > 0; all four required when rings is empty

rings

r:pa:incl:vrot,r:pa:incl:vrot,... (at most 4000 characters); each r > 0, incl in [0, 90], radii distinct; when given, the scalar model is ignored

Body: the selection mask.

Response (JSON, NaN replaced by null): width, height, sigma, sigma_source, velocity_convention, residual ({n_pix, median, p90, within_channel}), model_base64 (model velocity field) and velocity_field_base64 (observed), both height × width little-endian float32 in base64.

Errors (JSON detail): 422 for a body of the wrong length, a malformed rings string, duplicate radii, or a missing single-disc parameter; then as kinematic_fit_bin (404, 422, 413, 429, 504).

POST /v1/cube/save_channel_2d¶

Extracts one channel of a cube as a standalone 2-D FITS image (NAXIS=2, not a degenerate 3-D cube) in Workspace Exports and registers it as a new image dataset. The header carries the celestial WCS of the source (written without WCS when it cannot be extracted), BUNIT, OBJECT, TELESCOP, INSTRUME when present, the channel’s spectral coordinate as SPECVAL (with SPECTYPE and SPECUNIT from CTYPE3 and CUNIT3) when CRVAL3, CRPIX3 and CDELT3 exist, and a HISTORY card.

Request (CubeSaveChannel2dRequest): dataset_id, channel (0-indexed), output_basename (default "", giving <stem>_ch<NNNN>.fits with a four-digit channel number).

Response (CubeSaveChannel2dResponse): valid, error, new_dataset_id, output_path, workspace_filename, width, height, channel, range_min, range_max.

Errors: 404, 422 (not a cube), 429. A channel out of range and other worker failures return HTTP 200 with valid: false.

POST /v1/moment/result/binary¶

Moment map as a 12-byte frame (rows = height, cols = width). It shares the computation and the product cache of /v1/products/moment and /v1/tasks/moment, so an identical request is served from the cache.

Request (MomentProductRequest): dataset_id, moment_order (required), channel_start and channel_end (default 0 and 0; inclusive, clamped to the cube), mask_enabled (default false), threshold_value (default 0.0), threshold_auto (default false: when true with mask_enabled, the threshold is derived from the data as median + 3σ via MAD), moment2_variance (default false: order 2 returns the velocity dispersion; true returns the variance).

{ "dataset_id": "ds_1a2b3c4d5e6f", "moment_order": 1, "channel_start": 20,
  "channel_end": 80, "mask_enabled": true, "threshold_auto": true }

Response: one 12-byte frame of float32. Header X-Visivo-From-Cache: true or false. The unit and spectral metadata are not in the binary response; the JSON routes return them.

Errors: 404, 422 (a ValueError from the computation, for example a channel range with channel_start > channel_end or a dataset that is not a cube), 504, 500 for other failures (all as JSON detail). This route does not take a per-session compute slot.

POST /v1/pv/result/binary¶

Position-velocity diagram as a 12-byte frame (rows = depth, the number of channels; cols = num_samples along the path). It shares the computation and cache of /v1/cube/pv and /v1/tasks/pv.

Request (CubePvRequest): dataset_id, vertices (list of [x, y] cube pixel positions, 0-based, fractional values honoured; at least two distinct vertices), width_pixels (default 1; values below 1 are treated as 1).

{ "dataset_id": "ds_1a2b3c4d5e6f", "vertices": [[30.5, 40.0], [200.0, 180.25]], "width_pixels": 3 }

Response: one 12-byte frame of float32 and the X-Visivo-From-Cache header. Sample positions, the arcsec scale and the spectral axis are only in the JSON /v1/cube/pv response.

Errors: 404, 422 (not a cube, fewer than two distinct vertices or another ValueError), 504, 500. No per-session compute slot.
